episodes.title: RACHEL BERNSTEIN
episodes.description:
Episode Summary
 In this powerful conversation, Vanessa Reiser, LCSW, sits down with Rachel Bernstein — licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, cult specialist, and host of the acclaimed podcast Indoctrination — for a wide-ranging discussion on cult dynamics, narcissistic abuse, the loss of self, and the road to reclaiming your identity.
  Topics Covered
  How Rachel got into cult recovery work — a personal family experience with Scientology and a Holocaust-conscious upbringing that shaped her awareness of groupthink Why Scientology is the ultimate "masterclass" in cult-of-one domestic abuse dynamics — isolation, brainwashing, celebrity credibility, and financial entrapment ("freeload debt") The loss of self inside toxic relationships — how victims gradually take on a persona shaped by their abuser The unique challenge faced by those born into cults who have no prior identity to return to Practical tools for rebuilding identity: starting with who you are not, the DBT Pleasant Events List, and learning to make choices free from an abuser's influence The red car analogy: how even acts of rebellion can keep an abuser central — and what true autonomy looks like The danger of passive aggression: why it flies under the radar, how it chips away at self-worth over time, and why it may be more insidious than overt abuse The "God bless her" move — how toxic communicators in fundamentalist and cult settings wrap insults in false benevolence How to respond to passive aggression without absorbing it Narcissism, cult dynamics, and groupthink in current politics and culture Rachel's new app, journal, support groups, and upcoming book (expected February)  TIMESTAMPS:
